name: Radar grid and ruler
what: An upright radar-screen opener: a red grid, a big text dropping in word by word beside a sweeping radar and a dashed frame, then the camera dives through them to a rising red column that fills the screen and fades into a red ruler with a second text in its middle.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f4-f10: the words of the big text drop in one by one (each 133 px above and 1.33x big, settling in 10 f); f6-f18 radar discs fade in with a sweeping wedge, a dashed frame pops in at f10; f18-f48 the camera zooms in (accelerating) while the grid scrolls up and away (f24-f58) and a red column rises (f28-f48); f50-f66 the column zooms to fill the frame and fades to black (f55-f78); f68-f80 a red ruler scrolls up and the second text fades in (f72-f80); then it holds to f159. Everything changes every second frame (a setting).
